paragraphs: AI: "AI’s Circular Financing Spreads to Asia, Widening Contagion Risk" (Bloomberg.com) leads the coverage. Also notable: "AI & Tech Brief: Exclusive | The FCC’s battle on the Hill" (The Washington Post).

Political: "Freed Russian prisoner Stephen Hubbard tells Trump ‘I wouldn’t have lasted another year,’ during emotional Oval Office visit" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Judge opens inquiry into Trump administration’s handling of East Potomac golf course case" (Washington Examiner).
Economic: "Federal debt surpassed GDP for fiscal 2026" (The Hill) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Fed needs at least two more rate hikes, Logan says" (Reuters).

Financial: "People magazine publisher slashes 195 jobs as print and web businesses face shake-up" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Too Many Bills, Too Little Progress: How to Simplify a Debt Pileup" (New York Post).

Geopolitical: "Hundreds evacuate Ukrainian city of Oleshky as part of Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire" (Washington Examiner) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Canadian CEO speaks out about ‘horrific’ home invasion after masked men attacked him, daughters and wife" (New York Post).
